description: 图谱人物命名策略迁移与可配置化 — 将硬编码命名规则迁移到书籍配置，建立统一命名策略模块

userStories.title: 抽离统一人物命名策略模块
userStories.description: As a backend developer, I want a single graph name policy module so that all graph-related naming/alias rules come from one place and never diverge.
acceptanceCriteria: 新增模块 novel_system/graph_name_policy.py，暴露规范化、别名归并、候选过滤接口
service.py 与 graph_service.py 中重复的人名规范化/过滤逻辑已删除，改为调用 graph_name_policy
conda run -n chaishu python -c "from novel_system.graph_name_policy import normalize_name, resolve_aliases, filter_candidates" 成功
现有相关测试通过

userStories.title: 书籍级 graph 配置外置
userStories.description: As a data/operator, I want per-book graph profile files so that novel-specific knowledge is managed as data instead of hardcoded patches.
acceptanceCriteria: 支持读取 books/{book_id}/graph_profile.json，schema 包含 character_seeds、aliases、manual_fixes 字段
GRAPH_CANON_SEEDS / GRAPH_ALIAS_LOOKUP 从代码常量迁出到 graph_profile.json 配置
配置缺失时回落到默认启发式，不因缺文件导致流程中断
新增测试验证配置加载、回退、schema 校验

userStories.title: 索引阶段人物候选与过滤链路
userStories.description: As a retrieval/graph engineer, I want candidate extraction and filtering in indexing so that fake names are filtered before graph consumption.
acceptanceCriteria: 索引阶段产出人物候选集合（从 chunk text 中抽取人名）
候选过滤基于三类证据：出现频率、章节跨度、场景证据
过滤后生成 character_registry，包含 canonical name + aliases
同配置下对同一输入数据过滤结果稳定（可重复性）
新增测试覆盖候选抽取和过滤链路

userStories.title: Graph 消费面收敛到标准产物
userStories.description: As a graph pipeline maintainer, I want graph only consume normalized artifacts so that upstream changes do not repeatedly break graph rules.
acceptanceCriteria: graph 构建仅消费 character_registry、character_card、event_timeline 三类标准产物
graph 侧不再直接依赖原始名字补丁常量（如 GRAPH_CANON_SEEDS）
缺少关键产物时有明确日志或异常信号
现有图谱相关测试通过

userStories.title: 白名单与新书自动判定
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a whitelist policy with auto-detection for new books so that migration strategy is controllable and scalable.
acceptanceCriteria: 新增可配置白名单机制（配置文件或代码常量均可），用于特定策略启用/约束
系统自动判定新书是否在白名单中，按判定结果执行对应策略
白名单判定逻辑可测试：包含命中与未命中的样例测试
判定结果在日志或调试输出中可追踪

userStories.title: 一次性切换与回归验证
userStories.description: As a project owner, I want one-shot migration with strict verification so that architecture is cleaned up without long-term dual maintenance.
acceptanceCriteria: 不保留旧实现双轨逻辑（一次性切换）
新增迁移相关测试覆盖关键路径：配置加载回退、别名归并、候选过滤、白名单判定
conda run -n chaishu python -m pytest 通过
至少在一个样书上验证人物图谱效果：aliases 归并正确、假名过滤结果合理
